recipes.name: Jollof rice
recipes.description: A Suric home-cooking adaptation of Jollof rice, using accessible ingredients and a practical method inspired by Nationwide.
instructions: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear. Prepare the aromatic ingredients and measure the cooking liquid.
Cook the onion and seasonings in a saucepan, stir in the rice, then add the measured liquid and remaining ingredients.
Cover and cook gently until the rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Rest covered for 5 minutes, then fluff and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve with fried plantain and greens.
recipes.substitutions: Use vegetable stock and omit meat sides.
recipes.storage: Cool promptly, refrigerate covered and use within 3 days; reheat once until steaming. Chilled salads and spreads should be refrigerated and used within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Wash produce and use clean utensils. Refrigerate leftovers promptly; reheat once until steaming.
